name: Cathedral of the Good Shepherd
notes: Divine Mercy devotion is not held on public holidays.
Confession is subject to priest availability.
All Saints' Day Masses follow regular Mass timings.

info.confession: Confession is at the Main Church 15 minutes before Weekend Mass when priests are available.
devotions: Rosary on Zoom Monday-Wednesday 21:30; 4th Friday 12:30 at Temporary Chapel.
Divine Mercy Thursday 12:15 at Annex Building Level 3, except public holidays.
Breaking of the Word Thursday 20:00-21:30; Wednesday 11:00 at Annex, Level 2 Room 4.
Intercessory Prayers Wednesday 11:45 at Annex, Level 2 Room 4.
info.office_hours: Cathedral Office is open Monday-Friday 09:00-18:00 and closed on Public Holidays.
good_to_know: Main Church is closed Monday-Friday; open Saturday at 16:00 and full day on Sundays.
Temporary Chapel at JM Beurel Centre (Annex Building) Level 1 is open Monday-Friday 10:00-19:00.
